result.reason: The redline reaches the fallback by limiting the fee to three months’ Section 3.1 fees, applying it only to convenience termination, and excluding other liquidated amounts or penalties. However, stating that it is the “sole and exclusive amount payable” in connection with termination is broader than necessary and could inadvertently eliminate accrued fees or other legitimate non-liquidated payment obligations. It should instead be the sole early-termination fee or sole liquidated amount, without affecting amounts accrued before termination.
